statement: Pinned Linux hid-wiimote-core.c initializes a connected extension by writing 0x55 to 0xA400F0 then 0x00 to 0xA400FB, and performs the analogous writes to 0xA600F0 and 0xA600FB for MotionPlus; its following ID reads do not implement an encrypted session in that host path. This is a host consumer setup policy, not proof that encrypted physical operation is unsupported.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: hid-wiimote-core.c lines 410-486; complementary to existing wii-kernel-extension-init but also specifies MP initialization; no device-side promotion.
